description: The file defines the ManyToOneRelationship class in a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM module, managing metadata for many-to-one relationships, including construction, label building, subpanel and vardef construction, and relationship metadata handling.

classes.name: ManyToOneRelationship
classes.description: A class managing metadata for many-to-one relationships in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM, extending AbstractRelationship and utilizing OneToManyRelationship for core functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ManyToOneRelationship object with the provided definition, setting up related attributes and instantiating an internal OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: buildLabels
methods.description: Delegates label building to the internal OneToManyRelationship instance.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Generates subpanel definitions by delegating to the OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Builds vardef field definitions by delegating to the OneToManyRelationship object.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Returns module-specific fields to add to layouts, unless relationship_only is true.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves relationship metadata definitions via the internal OneToManyRelationship instance.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the relationship name and propagates it to the internal OneToManyRelationship.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the readonly status for the relationship and propagates to the internal OneToManyRelationship.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the relationship, including internal metadata managed by OneToManyRelationship.

methods.name: setRelationship_only
methods.description: Marks the relationship as relationship-only, propagating to internal OneToManyRelationship.
